references.text: God commands Moses to gather the elders of Israel, which is fulfilled here in 4:29.
Aaron meets Moses at God's mountain, and Moses tells him everything the Lord has said. This leads directly to them gathering the elders together.
Moses gathers the elders of Israel again to give them instructions about the Passover lamb.
The Lord commands Moses to gather seventy of the elders of Israel, showing the continued role of the elders in Israel's leadership.
Joshua gathers all the tribes of Israel and their elders, a parallel to Moses and Aaron's gathering of the elders.
Both events mark critical transitions in Israel's formation where Moses and Aaron gather the elders to confirm God's authority.
Connects the gathering to receive the command (chap. 4) with the complete obedience to that same command (chap. 12).
Same narrative line as candidate 6; shows the transition from gathering for a command to full obedience.
